# `LAYOUT_IRREGULAR_GAPS`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | info |
| Area | [Layout (`LAYOUT_`)](README.md#domain-layout) |
| Reported by | `mapper` |

## What happened

Margins could not be expressed as gaps, padding, wrappers or splits; the container is absolute.

## What to do

Use `gap` instead of per-child margins, or set `mapper.allowSpacers`.
